gloss: to rearrange; to reorder; to sort

definitions.gloss: to rearrange; to reorder; to sort
definitions.explanation: To change the order or arrangement of items, putting them in a different sequence or configuration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧あいうえお{順|じゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{並|なら}べ{替|か}えた。
examples.english: I rearranged the names in alphabetical order.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{並|なら}べ{替|か}えて⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{模様替|もようが}え→模様替え：07708_moyougae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I rearranged the furniture and redecorated the room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優先度|ゆうせんど}→優先度：29132_yuusendo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦タスク→タスク：06765_tasuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{並|なら}べ{替|か}えて、⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めよう→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's rearrange the tasks in order of priority and work efficiently.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧ (to line up, to arrange) + ⟦{替|か}える→替える：13399_kaeru⟧ (to change, to replace). The combination means to change the existing arrangement into a new one. Very common in both physical contexts (rearranging objects) and digital contexts (sorting lists, reordering data).

This is an ichidan verb that conjugates like ⟦{替|か}える→替える：13399_kaeru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{並|なら}べ{替|か}える: to change the order
- あいうえお⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{並|なら}べ{替|か}える: to sort in Japanese alphabetical order
- ⟦{日付|ひづけ}→日付：03706_hizuke⟧⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{並|なら}べ{替|か}える: to sort by date
- ⟦{大|おお}きさ→大きさ：10969_ookisa⟧⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{並|なら}べ{替|か}える: to sort by size

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧: to line up; to arrange — placing items in order, without the nuance of rearranging
- ⟦{整理|せいり}する→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧: to organize; to tidy — broader, includes discarding and categorizing
- ソート⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sort — loanword used mainly in computing and data contexts
